run_inverted_pendulum_simulation: run the pybullet inverted pendulum tendon actuation PID control simulation in GUI mode
create_constraint_between_bodies: create a fixed joint constraint between two URDF bodies using p.createConstraint with joint indices
set_joint_motor_control: set velocity control on a joint with p.setJointMotorControl2 specifying target velocity and force
load_urdf_and_query_joints: load a URDF model with p.loadURDF then enumerate joints with p.getNumJoints and p.getJointInfo
plot_simulation_history: plot control input and pendulum angle history using matplotlib with dual y-axis from numpy arrays
